$comment: pulley/registry/blocks/roles/manifest.json — created 2026-08-13 (T-12): the roles core block. Org-scoped permissions on CASL. DEPENDS ON auth (the subject of a grant is an auth_user) AND org (the scope of a grant is an org_organization) — both foreign keys are real, so the install order auth -> org -> roles is enforced by the database, not by convention. Written against the T-10b manifest surfaces from the start: `endpoints` mounts the two HTTP surfaces, `routes[].load` feeds each page its server data with the data type exported beside the load, and `nav.href` names the target instead of inheriting whichever route is listed first. No `ports` — permissions need no vendor. No `providesAdapters` — this block ships none. DATABASE_URL is declared with flags byte-identical to auth's and org's, which the resolver treats as a shared variable (warning) rather than a conflict.
name: roles
description: Org-scoped roles and permissions: CASL abilities composed from membership plus custom role assignments, enforced by a server guard.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Postgres connection string the roles tables live in. Same database as auth and org — role assignments hold foreign keys into auth_user and org_organization.
